fields.name: set
fields.description: Add a key/value pair with key KEY and value VALUE.

fields.name: add
fields.description: Add a key/value pair with key KEY and value VALUE if KEY doesn't exist.

fields.name: remove
fields.description: Remove a key/value pair with key KEY if it exists.

fields.name: remove_wildcard
fields.description: Remove all key/value pairs with key matching wildcard KEY.

fields.name: remove_regex
fields.description: Remove all key/value pairs with key matching regexp KEY.

fields.name: rename
fields.description: Rename a key/value pair with key KEY to RENAMED_KEY if KEY exists and RENAMED_KEY doesn't exist.

fields.name: hard_rename
fields.description: Rename a key/value pair with key KEY to RENAMED_KEY if KEY exists.

fields.name: copy
fields.description: Copy a key/value pair with key KEY to COPIED_KEY if KEY exists and COPIED_KEY doesn't exist.

fields.name: hard_copy
fields.description: Copy a key/value pair with key KEY to COPIED_KEY if KEY exists.

fields.name: move_to_start
fields.description: Move key/value pairs with keys matching KEY to the start of the message.

fields.name: move_to_end
fields.description: Move key/value pairs with keys matching KEY to the end of the message.

fields.name: match
fields.description: Tag match pattern used to route records to this plugin. Supports '*' wildcard matching.

fields.name: match_regex
fields.description: Regular expression tag match used to route records to this plugin. Takes precedence over match when both are set.
